name.baseName: xx Disposal, biowaste, to agricultural co-fermentation, covered

dataSetInformation.common:generalComment: This process can only be used together with the process "biogas, mix, at agricultural co-fermentation, covered" because bio waste is not treated in agricultural biogas plants alone but only together with liquid manure. This process has been generated to give the possibility to model co-fermentation with different inputs. The multioutput-process "bio waste, to agriculture co-fermentation, covered" delivers the co-products "biogas", "application of digested matter" and the service "disposal of bio waste". The functional unit refers to 1 kg fresh matter of vegetable and organic waste and catering waste. The allocation is based on economic criteria. ; UUID: f4fe8e73-1a59-3a87-834c-ebf2c6ff4e21

locationOfOperationSupplyOrProduction.descriptionOfRestrictions: This dataset is valid for agricultural plants in Switzerland in the year 2006

technology.technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse:
To reduce methane emission the stock container is covered, to reduce NH3 emissions the digested matter will be spread with a trail hose.

# Included processes
This process contains the infrastructure, the energy used and the emissions of the fermentation process.

dataSourcesTreatmentAndRepresentativenes.samplingProcedure: field data, The data are the average of 20 plants in Switzerland to produce electricity according the criteria of "naturemade".
